name: Reverse Risk Reversal (Synthetic Short Stock / Collar Without Stock)
summary: Buy a put and sell a call at the same strike and expiry; replicates 100 short shares with delta -1.00. This is the structure people mean when they say 'a collar without the stock' -- and without the stock it is not a collar, it is a naked synthetic short.

legs.strike_rule: ATM strike, identical to the call's strike.

max_profit: (strike * 100) - net cost, as the underlying approaches zero
max_loss: UNDEFINED -- unlimited above the strike, exactly like being short 100 shares
breakevens: strike - net debit per share (or strike + net credit per share)
when_to_use: Used institutionally to short hard-to-borrow names without a borrow. For this account: never. The short call is uncovered and the loss is unbounded to the upside, which is the worst risk profile available.
entry_rules: BLOCKED ON THIS ACCOUNT. The short call is uncovered -- Level 4, which Alpaca does not offer. Alpaca's MLeg engine rejects it outright.

IMPORTANT NAMING NOTE: a true COLLAR is long 100 shares + long put + short call, and is a Level 1/2 hedged structure. Strip out the stock and the short call becomes naked. The system must never build a 'collar' without first verifying 100 long shares per contract exist in the account, and Alpaca does not accept equity legs inside an MLeg order, so a real collar must be assembled as separate orders.
Defined-risk substitute that expresses the same view: a bear call spread or a bear put spread.
If it were enabled: same strike both legs, DTE 45-90, and the combo must price near synthetic-forward fair value.
management_rules: If enabled: manage as 100 short shares -- a hard stop above resistance, and a mandatory buy-in rule.
Close before every ex-dividend date: a short synthetic owes the dividend if the short call is assigned.
exit_rules: Flat by 15:45 ET on expiration day.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: the short call goes ITM on any rally -- exactly when the trade is losing. Close the combo the moment the short call's extrinsic drops below $0.10.
DIVIDEND GUARD: close by the close of the session before ex-dividend whenever the short call is ITM and extrinsic < 1.5 * the dividend.
Close if the underlying is above (strike - $0.05) at 15:30 ET on expiry day.
assignment_risk: The short call is naked. Assignment creates a short stock position of 100 shares per unit with no long stock and only a long put as economic (not operational) cover. On a dividend payer you would also owe the dividend. This is the highest-consequence assignment scenario in the two-leg family.
buying_power: Reg-T naked call margin, roughly 20% of underlying value minus OTM amount plus premium. Not available on Alpaca.
liquidity_needs: ATM strikes; combo should quote near synthetic fair value.
common_mistakes: Calling it a collar and assuming it is conservative; opening it with the intention of buying the shares later; ignoring dividend liability on the short call.
zero_dte_notes: Guaranteed assignment on one leg at expiry and no time for the view to work. Not permitted.
family: Two-leg verticals and same-expiry two-leg combos (call/put verticals, straddles, strangles, guts, synthetics/risk reversals, ratio verticals and backspreads)
blocked_because: needs Alpaca options level 4; this account is level 3. Alpaca rejects it with 'account not eligible to trade uncovered option contracts'. Raising the level is an Alpaca approval, not a code change.
